title: Therapeutic Potential of Nitrogen-Substituted Oleanolic Acid Derivatives in Neuroinflammatory and Cytokine Pathways: Insights From Cell-Based and Computational Models.
authors: Turgut, Gurbet Celik; Pepe, Nihan Aktas; Ekiz, Yagmur Ceylan; Senol, Halil; Sen, Alaattin
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦氮取代齐墩果酸衍生物的抗神经炎症机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合研究无关。
abstract: This study was conducted to investigate the mechanism of the potential and anti-inflammatory properties of nitrogen-substituted oleanolic acid derivatives that can be used to treat neuroinflammatory diseases. Nitrogen-containing oleanolic acid derivatives have been evaluated for their anti-neuroinflammatory effects in vitro in neuronal and monocytic cell lines at nontoxic doses, and the production of cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6 and IL-17), the inflammatory enzyme induced nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and NF-kappaB signalling under LPS-stimulated conditions, and the expression of genes associated with Alzheimer's disease have been assessed. In addition, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation assessments are conducted in silico. Key protein markers of neurodegenerative diseases, especially Alzheimer's disease and neuroinflammation, TAU protein levels, and microglial activation, as well as ionised calcium-binding adaptor protein-1 (IBA1) levels, were significantly reduced with the addition of oleanolic acid derivatives. LPS-induced NF-kappaB luciferase reporter activity and iNOS activity were significantly inhibited, approaching the levels in uninduced controls. The mRNA expression of proinflammatory cytokines critical for neuroinflammation, such as TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, IL-6 and IL-17, was reduced twofold to sevenfold. Furthermore, the molecular docking and MD simulation analyses revealed potential interactions with the TNF-alpha and NF-kappaB proteins. These findings underscore the potential of oleanolic acid derivatives, particularly compound 16, as candidates for further development as therapeutic agents for neurodegenerative diseases associated with chronic inflammation.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨含氮取代的齐墩果酸衍生物在治疗神经炎症疾病方面的潜力及其抗炎作用机制。在体外实验中，于非毒性剂量下评估了含氮齐墩果酸衍生物对神经元和单核细胞系抗神经炎症效应，并检测了脂多糖（LPS）刺激条件下细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-6和IL-17）的产生、炎症酶诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）及NF-κB信号通路，以及与阿尔茨海默病相关基因的表达。此外，还进行了分子对接和分子动力学模拟的计算机评估。添加齐墩果酸衍生物后，神经退行性疾病（尤其是阿尔茨海默病和神经炎症）的关键蛋白标志物、TAU蛋白水平、小胶质细胞活化以及离子化钙结合适配器蛋白-1（IBA1）水平均显著降低。LPS诱导的NF-κB荧光素酶报告基因活性和iNOS活性被显著抑制，接近未诱导对照组水平。对神经炎症至关重要的促炎细胞因子（如TNF-α、NF-κB、IL-6和IL-17）的mRNA表达降低了2至7倍。此外，分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析揭示了与TNF-α和NF-κB蛋白的潜在相互作用。这些发现强调了齐墩果酸衍生物（尤其是化合物16）作为治疗与慢性炎症相关神经退行性疾病的候选药物进一步开发的潜力。
